notes: These 26 script-referenced constructors plus two shared initializers are reconstructed C; no original class names are asserted.
Source reuses observed gameplay goal/actor and math vector layouts plus the recovered Deimos retain helper. Macros share only instruction-proven repeated constructor patterns.
Opaque bytes are deliberately left untouched. Pointees with byte +5 and owner halfword +24 are separate partial types; their original classes and lifetime contracts remain unknown.
The +0C addresses are dispatch-table bindings containing matching nearby method entry addresses. No original table data is claimed as new C recovery.
All metadata sizes and SHA256 fingerprints describe original instructions, including return delay slots and excluding alignment padding.
m2c 708d2d2 research drafts were reviewed against every original instruction; omitted owner arguments and stale extra GPR arguments were corrected using callee and caller evidence.
Candidate compiler identity remains unproved. Status becomes matched only after the complete linked function bytes are identical.

All 28 routines compiled and linked with both gcc323 and gcc29 candidate profiles using the common O2/G0/mfp64/no-builtin/no-strict-aliasing/function-sections options; gcc323 also used no-reorder-blocks. No exact matches. Both candidates emit sd/ld callee saves where retail constructors use sq/lq; GCC2.9 narrows many body scheduling differences without resolving ABI identity.

Independent instruction and partial-layout review passed the six exceptional constructors/initializers 1E84D0, 1DF028, 1DC5A0, 1E0C38, 1E5AA8, and 1DC538; this semantic review does not assert compiler matching.

GEORGE_SAVE128 annotations are applied only to the 26 observed nonleaf constructor declarations and expand to nothing in the default recipe. An additional GCC2.9 probe with -DGEORGE_USE_SAVE128 produces genuine sq/lq without backend changes or inline assembly; zero new exact matches because save-slot order and scheduling still differ.
